name: Kannada CARV
description: Kannada CARV is RVCE's theatre club, where thoughts turn into vision through writing, acting, production design, music, and technical artistry. We tell stories through centre-stage productions, street plays, mad ads, and mime that have earned recognition across campuses. With initiatives like Rangataranga, Rangaparva, CARV Lekha, and Carvinal we provide every member a platform to learn, create, perform and grow in the direction they desire.

events.name: ​🎭 Mad Ads
events.detail: Pitching products with a punchline! Watch our creative minds blend brilliant marketing strategies with instant, unscripted comedy. It’s hilarious, smart, and hands-down the most entertaining sales pitch you’ll ever see.

events.name: Video Showcase
events.detail: Take a trip down memory lane. Grab a seat and check out this exclusive visual showcase of our club's past masterpieces, boldest projects, and proudest achievements. See what we're all about!

events.name: ​🎤 Open Mic: Jam Session
events.detail: Grab the mic or just vibe with the crowd! This is a laid-back, open-floor jamming session featuring theatrical hits, soulful folklore, and everything in between. Whether you're a seasoned singer or just want to sing along, the floor is open—come blend in!

events.name: Interactive Improv
events.detail: Zero acting experience? No problem! Jump into the madness where the topics are instant, the scenarios change constantly, and the laughter never stops. It’s wild, highly interactive, unpredictable, and guarantees unlimited fun for everyone involved.
